title: DismineSMP
body:
### **🔔 Welcome to Dismine SMP!**
Dismine SMP is a community-driven Minecraft survival server built for players who enjoy the classic survival experience with modern enhancements. Our server uses powerful plugins to improve gameplay while keeping the vanilla feel of Minecraft.

Whether you're a creative builder, a fearless explorer, a redstone engineer, or a competitive player, Dismine SMP offers a friendly and stable world where everyone can create their own adventure.


### **✨ Server Features**

Enhanced Survival: Carefully selected plugins improve gameplay while maintaining the original Minecraft survival experience.

Custom Features: Enjoy unique items, events, and systems that make the server more fun and engaging.

Community Events: Participate in exciting server events such as building contests, PvP tournaments, and special challenges.

Optimized Performance: Our server is optimized for smooth gameplay, ensuring minimal lag and a stable experience even with many players online.


### **🛠️ How to Join**

Joining Dismine SMP is simple! Since the server is plugin-based, you don't need to install any modpacks. Just join using the correct Minecraft version.

## Version: 26.2
Server IP: play.disminesmp.qzz.io                                                          
Discord: https://discord.gg/DWh2phqz

### **🤝 Community First**

We focus on creating a friendly and respectful environment where everyone can enjoy playing together. Follow the rules, respect other players, and most importantly — have fun in Dismine SMP!
